goal: Determine whether the frozen Stage-12d MFI-Edge signature controller generalizes beyond UDED, while preserving strict separation between development data and external/final test data; then decide whether to close this model generation or open a new literature-guided development cycle.
success_criteria: A frozen Stage-12d representative is evaluated without tuning on BSDS500 external test.
The same frozen family is independently replicated on another external dataset/protocol such as BIPED without using BSDS test feedback for tuning.
Any publication-grade BSDS claim is reproduced with the official Berkeley evaluation protocol before promotion to main.
Runtime, resolution policy, qualitative outputs, exact frozen configuration, and calibration source are documented.

If the frozen family fails to generalize sufficiently, a new development cycle is opened only on development data; literature escalation must propose mechanistically distinct hypotheses and a minimal falsification experiment.

external_test_no_tuning: BIPED test when used as frozen replication
optimization_policy.rule: Never choose or alter hyperparameters, descriptors, thresholds, operator choices, or architecture using an external/final test result.

autonomy_policy.normal_mode: Use low reasoning and repository-local evidence to interpret a completed experiment and prepare one next allow-listed experiment.
autonomy_policy.research_escalation: Use medium reasoning plus live web search when available for protocol planning, exhausted hypothesis queues, contradictory evidence, or repeated development stagnation.
autonomy_policy.stagnation_rule: After three consecutive failed development hypotheses from the same mechanism family, stop micro-tuning that family and research a mechanistically different direction.
autonomy_policy.one_change_rule: Prefer one interpretable mechanism change per development iteration and a minimal falsification test.

next_sequence: literature-guided development escalation only if a new generation is scientifically warranted
stop_conditions: Codex requires a protected scientific-file change
no scientifically valid allow-listed next experiment exists
a dataset/evaluator ambiguity requires human methodological review
an external dataset requires credentials or license acceptance that cannot be automated safely
